name: Theme Modal
description: Theme palette picker dialog. Displays two radio groups: THEMES (Default, Monokai, Idol) and LIGHT/DARK mode. Preselected to current theme state. Apply button calls theme.setTheme(base, mode) and closes. Cancel button discards changes. Overlay click = close. Escape key = close. Rerenders on each open() to reflect current state.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Rerender with current theme state, show modal, register close callback
